newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman extends gains on recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Hackman extends gains on recommendations.

text.p: Shares in Finnish diversified consumer goods group Hackman Oy Ab rose on Friday on continued demand and positive recommendations from brokerage houses, brokers said.
At 1445/1145 GMT, Hackman traded at 159.00 markka, up 9.00 markka or 6.00 percent. Trade was a moderate 3.4 million markka.
Merita had a "two" stance -- meaning it expected outperformance compared to the HEX portfolio index -- which is its second highest recommendation, a Merita analyst said.
The market also talked of other, even more positive views on the company.
Hackman has added 17 percent from Monday's close since it on Tuesday said that its environmental technology group Hadwaco had entered a marketing partnership with U.S. Filter Corporation.
Brokers were also upbeat on new CEO Tapio Hintikka.
"Hackman is a good story all in all," said one analyst.
